name: perf-rig
description: Frame-timing capture and scoring for web apps on real devices, with input and measurement on separate channels.

x-notes.no-dependencies: The WebKit Inspector client uses the global WebSocket (Node 22); the WebDriver client is hand-rolled over fetch. The package never depends on ws, appium or webdriverio.
x-notes.peer: playwright-core is pinned to the same range as the consuming app's @playwright/test and a drift guard in the consumer holds the two resolved versions equal; the nested rung's pnpm-workspace.yaml sets autoInstallPeers: false so a mismatch cannot install silently.
x-notes.host-tools: adb, xcrun, idevice_id, iproxy, pymobiledevice3, an Appium server, perfetto and xctrace are discovered by doctor, never installed.
x-notes.install-scripts: None. The nested rung is consumed as a link: entry under the root's devDependencies; the published rung as an exact-pinned devDependencies entry. Neither runs a lifecycle script, so nothing is registered under allowBuilds.
